design.baseline: User attachment plus previously saved version1 annotations and immutable SVG source
design.onlineIssue: Selected version1 in browser; login state change prevented canvas/annotation loading.

wkWebViewTests.scope: Offscreen actual bundled WKWebView with native Bridge; synthetic safe area variables; initial read failure, retry, refresh failure, draft retention, publish exit and existing en/fr auth/help/discovery regression.

limitations: Physical iPhone and real system keyboard not verified.
Synthetic safe areas and offscreen WebKit do not establish physical-device conclusions.
Glass gradient and white artwork contour reconstructed from attachment; exact original version1 fill/path parameters require online review.
Browser captures are JPEG even when screenshot API is used; no lossless pixel-equality claim.
